snippet.title: KreatureKind Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Aurora Punks is proud to have acted as the publishing partner for KreatureKind developed by Valiant Game Studio - a wholesome, hand-drawn deckbuilder where you play as a group of activists debating cute monsters to save a world running out of magic. With turn-based strategy, a lot of heart, and a focus on empathy over fighting, it’s a fresh take on what it means to be a hero.

🎮 Find it on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428090/KreatureKind/ 

About KreatureKind:

KreatureKind is a narrative-rich deckbuilder set in a colorful, hand-drawn world where magic is fading, unless its wasteful inhabitants change their ways. Players lead a group of activists trying to save magic by debating quirky cryptids and mythological monsters. With tactical card play, heartfelt storytelling, and cozy vibes, the game invites players to rethink what it means to win a battle and to be heroic.

- Solve conflicts through kindness and clever card play instead of traditional combat. 
- Explore themes of change, compassion, and empathy.
- Meet a vibrant cast of adorable, hand-drawn monsters.
- Build and customize your deck to suit your strategy.
- Embrace a new kind of heroism — one built on saving, not destroying. 

#indiegames #KreatureKind #AuroraPunks
